subject: Status: encoder integrated, feedback loop demo on track, schema debt
body:
Hi both,

Status. The knowledge-graph encoder is integrated with the base forecaster as of 3/5 - a day early. On the internal logistics benchmark, conditioning on the meta-data graph cuts MAPE from 11.8% to 9.6% at the 2-week horizon; the win concentrates exactly where the partner's operation-logistics rules constrain the forecast, which is the story we wanted.

Feedback ingestion is on track for the 3/27 demo: a user correction becomes a graph edit, and Ondrej's incremental-update path retrains the affected embeddings in minutes, not hours.

The debt is schemas. Paloma normalized two of the three partner meta-data schemas; the third (the market-principles one) encodes rules as free text and needs a parsing step we did not scope. Recommendation: demo with two schemas and flag the third as a pilot-phase task with an owner, rather than rushing a fragile parser.

Hyun
